subject.title: feat(models): curate default model picker to current-generation catalogs

question: Should the approved curation policy hide lifecycle-deprecated rows only from default/configured pickers while keeping the `provider-config` inventory complete?
rationale: The PR states a maintainer-directed product decision, but the current implementation conflicts with the documented inventory-view boundary; maintainers need to confirm the intended permanent view contract.

options.title: Keep inventory views complete
options.body: Restrict lifecycle hiding to default and configured picker views and retain every provider-authored row in `all` and `provider-config` views.

options.title: Curate every view
options.body: Intentionally change the `provider-config` contract as well, update the documentation and consumers, and accept that it is no longer a complete provider inventory.

recommendation.title: Keep inventory views complete
recommendation.body: Restrict lifecycle hiding to default and configured picker views and retain every provider-authored row in `all` and `provider-config` views.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR description identifies the curation policy and the branch contains the central model-catalog implementation.
